tasks.name: git-history
tasks.prompt: Minimize token/context bloat. Inspect the repository history with git log. Confirm there are exactly 121 commits and the oldest subject is ATS seed. Compute the count and oldest subject inside the shell command before output reaches the model. If both are true, reply exactly ATS_HISTORY_OK and nothing else.

commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'count=$(git log --format=%H | wc -l | tr -d '"' '); oldest="'$(git log --reverse --format=%s | sed -n '"'1p'); if [ \""'$count" = 121 ] && [ "$oldest" = '"'ATS seed' ]; then printf '%s' ATS_HISTORY_OK; else printf '%s|%s' \""'$count" "$oldest"; fi'

/bin/zsh -lc 'commit_count=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) && oldest_subject=$(git log --format=%s --reverse | head -n 1) && if [ "$commit_count" -eq 121 ] && [ "$oldest_subject" = "ATS seed" ]; then printf '"'OK\\n'; else printf 'NOT_OK\\n'; fi"
